title: ResultSafe identity and naming policy
summary: Normative naming, UUID, reference, digest, revision, public handle, and authority rules for ResultSafe records.

field_rules.ref_suffix: Absolute URI or URN; corpus records use urn:uuid:<uuid>
field_rules.key_suffix: Natural, external, or business key that is not instance identity
field_rules.digest_suffix: Lowercase cryptographic digest with an explicitly named algorithm
field_rules.position_revision_sequence_suffixes: Nonnegative integer with no UUID-derived ordering

uuidv7_rules: Generate with current-millisecond field and cryptographically secure random bits
Persist each allocation by stable semantic allocation key
Never derive UUIDv7 from a name
Never use UUIDv7 as authorization, tenant boundary, secret, ordering, or trusted timestamp
Reject uppercase, whitespace, wrong version, and wrong RFC variant instead of normalizing
public_handle_rules: Use only canonical lowercase RFC 9562 UUIDv4
Treat as an opaque rotatable locator and never as authorization
Interpret federated handles as origin authority plus public handle
reference_rules: Use urn:uuid for globally unambiguous corpus entity references
Do not claim an unregistered custom string is a global RFC 8141 URN namespace
Do not encode mutable filesystem paths as canonical identity
tenant_rules: Every tenant-owned primary and foreign key includes tenant_id
No identifier grants authorization or permits cross-tenant disclosure
publication_rules: ResultSafe internal IDs are independent from AASDVGS publication envelope IDs
AASDVGS PackageFamilyId, ReleaseId, and PNID require their owning authority
Legacy UUIDv5 publication metadata is never a ResultSafe entity ID
